_about: What each check's error is a percentage of, for checks measured in physical units (checks already in % need nothing; an NSE check reads as 100 × (1 − NSE), the share of the measured variance the model misses). Used by the site to report every result as a percent difference from the right answer (site/difference.py, docs/methodology/ranking.md). Mean depths are the exact solution's mean over the domain on the finest grid, the same average the error is taken over (scripts/difference_scales.py prints them).
